content: Magnesium gluconate is a chemical compound with the molecular formula MgC12H22O14. It is the magnesium salt derived from gluconic acid. Scientific studies have demonstrated that magnesium gluconate possesses the highest bioavailability among all magnesium salts, making it the most effective form for human supplementation. Despite this, research has shown that all ten magnesium salts studied significantly increased magnesium levels in the body. Magnesium gluconate is also identified by the food additive code E580. Magnesium gluconate has been studied for its pharmacological properties. Gluconic acid, a component of magnesium gluconate, serves as a precursor in the pentose phosphate pathway, which is involved in the oxidative metabolism of glucose. This has led to the hypothesis that magnesium gluconate may influence mitochondrial energy metabolism. In Ukraine, magnesium gluconate is combined with potassium gluconate in a medication called Rhythmocor, which is used to treat heart diseases. Preliminary studies have indicated that this combination may be effective in managing various types of cardiac arrhythmias.
